items.question: What action toward camels produces a paralyzing effect after conquering a four-limbed army?
premises: A four-limbed army has been conquered.
Camels are the objects in question.
A paralyzing agent is brought into play.
items.inference: Conquest of a four-limbed army enables the production of a paralyzing effect upon camels.
uncertainties: Agency of the action remains unspecified
Contextual scope of application is unclear
items.plain_english: Having conquered a four-limbed army, one brings about paralysis of camels.
